item.title: Pakistan ranks lowest in South Asia on hunger index amid rising food prices
item.description: Pakistan's 2026 Global Hunger Index standings reveal an alarming crisis, showcasing the worst performance in South Asia amid ongoing economic challenges. Soaring food prices and the increasing frequency of climate-related disasters have sharply intensified food insecurity. With around 218 million individuals in South Asia experiencing undernourishment from 2023 to 2025, urgent strategies are required to bolster access to healthy food and enhance agricultural resilience against severe weather patterns. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.description: Hong Kong suffered a record net loss of 40 kindergartens this year amid a shrinking student population and as the median age of women giving birth to their first child rose to its highest yet, according to official figures.
